method.phash: DCT-II 32x32, top-left 8x8, DC excluded, median threshold, 63 bits
method.verification: 16x16 grayscale z-normalised cross-correlation >= 0.95; pHash supplies candidates only, because low-texture leaf images collide in hash space and union-find then chains unrelated crops into one cluster

verification_calibration.negative_control_note: Random pairs are not guaranteed non-duplicates — these corpora contain genuine duplicates, so the maximum can legitimately reach 1.0. Read the mean and p99, not the max.

method.known_limitation: Rotated/flipped/heavily-recoloured copies are not detected: pHash is not rotation-invariant, so augmented variants of an image may score as unrelated. Cotton's augmented split must therefore be excluded from val/test wholesale rather than relied on being caught here.

label_conflicts.explanation: Near-identical images carrying different class codes. Each pair is either a labelling error or a genuinely ambiguous case; both matter for the split strategy.

cotton_od1_gate.note: Label-error rate is a human judgement from the contact sheets and is NOT measured here. The mechanical verdict covers count and near-duplicate criteria only; the team owns the OD-1 decision.
